question: In a certain code language, 'LEMON' is written as 'ELMNO'. How will 'CLUSTER' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9b6902020fbecd46103c24153d94dbf33a30ac4d77746697363e5b1668076d4.png] 

'LEMON' is written as 'ELMNO'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2aa3a301583fc20c55707a984942ff3143d4629ff84717ff50dd02a430f5add8.png] 

Similarly,

'CLUSTER' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd0af153e33420a75e0faa32d3c543b3faec70ee2c738cec5a21f8bd7880b96b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CELRSTU".**
